scenes.role: Establish the shared cart, its rattle, and the children's ordinary aims.
prerequisites: The adventure has not started.
actions: Notice the wheel rattle; ask for help with a practical task.
consequences: Jo wants to be trusted; Mina needs her seedlings delivered.
prose_obligations: Make the cart shared property, not Jo's reward.
scenes.mapping_note: Combined with asking Len for the tool and hearing his caution.

scenes.role: Borrow the tool under ordinary caretaker supervision.
prerequisites: Len owns and has stored the spanner.
actions: Borrow the spanner.
consequences: Jo has custody; Len no longer has the tool ready in his toolbox.
prose_obligations: Make the loan and its intended use clear.
scenes.mapping_note: Consolidated into the cart-arrival opening encounter.

scenes.role: Give Jo a caution that will matter after the wrong first attempt.
prerequisites: Jo asks Len for a tool.
actions: Len distinguishes a sound from a diagnosis.
consequences: The story can recall the advice without making Jo omniscient.
prose_obligations: Keep Len practical rather than instructional.
scenes.mapping_note: Spoken in the same implemented scene as the loan.

scenes.role: Optional ownership-and-character vignette.
prerequisites: The cart is still untouched.
actions: Mina writes both children's names on the cart.
consequences: A persistent mark can be recalled at an ending.
prose_obligations: The names must not imply exclusive ownership.
scenes.mapping_note: Optional; omitted routes do not write names offstage.

scenes.role: Make the first diagnosis confidently and wrongly.
prerequisites: Jo has borrowed a fitting spanner or obtained an adjustable one.
actions: Steady the cart; try the spanner; tighten the wheel nut.
consequences: The hub is pinched, the wheel stops, and the rattle remains.
prose_obligations: Show the action and its contradictory result.
scenes.mapping_note: The implementation combines the diagnosis, tool-fit check, and tightening.

scenes.role: Respect tool fit instead of narrating an impossible turn.
prerequisites: Jo holds the borrowed spanner.
actions: Check the jaws; ask Len for an adjustable spanner if they slip.
consequences: Only a fitting tool turns the nut.
prose_obligations: If the first tool does not fit, enact the exchange.
scenes.mapping_note: Local alternatives inside first_attempt, not separate global scenes.

scenes.role: Keep the cart from creeping while Jo works.
prerequisites: The cart is at the bench.
actions: Use the level surface or wedge the frame on a sloping bench.
consequences: The work is physically supported.
prose_obligations: Do not require a wedge on a level bench.
scenes.mapping_note: Consolidated with the tool-fit and wrong-diagnosis play.

scenes.role: Let the first attempt produce evidence against itself.
prerequisites: The spanner fits and the wheel nut is snug.
actions: Turn the nut once; try the wheel.
consequences: The wheel binds while the side-to-side rattle persists.
prose_obligations: Do not claim the cart was repaired here.
scenes.mapping_note: The enacted result is one atomic scene outcome.

scenes.role: Give the child space to reconsider instead of forcing a lecture.
prerequisites: The first attempt has jammed the wheel.
actions: Mina notices; Jo must choose how to respond.
consequences: The response affects trust and the ending's emotional tone.
prose_obligations: Keep Mina observant, not punitive.
scenes.mapping_note: The choice is represented by two mutually exclusive executable scenes.

scenes.role: Reinspect the physical fault after the failed guess.
prerequisites: The wheel is jammed and the rattle persists.
actions: Feel the hub shift sideways.
consequences: Jo identifies the missing spacer.
prose_obligations: Tie the revised diagnosis to an observable gap.
scenes.mapping_note: Combines touching the wheel and recognizing the missing part.

scenes.role: Name the actual cause rather than simply undoing the first attempt.
prerequisites: The first attempt has been enacted.
actions: Compare hub and fork; see where the washer should sit.
consequences: The first diagnosis is explicitly wrong.
prose_obligations: Make the missing spacer explain both symptoms.
scenes.mapping_note: Same local play as feeling the side play.

scenes.role: Optional vignette that gives the children an embodied reminder.
prerequisites: Jo has found the missing spacer.
actions: Len shares a brief mistake from his own repairs.
consequences: Jo remembers advice to listen before tightening.
prose_obligations: Advice reinforces an observation; it does not reveal the washer.
scenes.mapping_note: Optional; the diagnostic discovery is already complete without it.

scenes.role: Choose to own the mistake promptly.
prerequisites: The diagnosis is corrected; admission style is early.
actions: Jo tells Mina the first guess was wrong.
consequences: Trust rises before the repair.
prose_obligations: Make honesty cost Jo pride but earn Mina's cooperation.
scenes.mapping_note: Exclusive alternative to keeping face until the ending.

scenes.role: Choose to postpone an uncomfortable truth.
prerequisites: The diagnosis is corrected; admission style is late.
actions: Jo avoids explaining the first mistake yet.
consequences: The later apology is less easy and trust starts lower.
prose_obligations: Do not make the child cruel or Mina unreasonable.
scenes.mapping_note: Exclusive alternative to admitting the error at once.

scenes.role: Make the correct repair with a real spacer and safe clearance.
prerequisites: A washer is in the parts tin; the correct diagnosis is known.
actions: Set excess load aside; take and fit the washer; adjust the nut.
consequences: The wheel turns freely without side play or rattle.
prose_obligations: Show the borrowed spanner's useful work and the tested clearance.
scenes.mapping_note: Load handling and washer installation are one repair scene with guarded local actions.

scenes.role: Choose safety when the proper part is absent.
scenes.location: courtyard repair bench and exchange table
prerequisites: No washer is available; the cart still has side play.
actions: Do not substitute cardboard; secure the cart and carry the pots by hand.
consequences: Repair fails, but the delivery is completed and the cart is clearly parked.
prose_obligations: Give the failure an emotionally complete outcome, not a false repair.
scenes.mapping_note: A distinct safe-stop scene replaces the repair scene when no washer exists.

scenes.role: Test the corrected wheel under a safe load and complete the delivery.
prerequisites: The washer is fitted and load does not exceed capacity.
actions: Roll the pots over the courtyard paving.
consequences: Successful movement confirms the wheel is usable.
prose_obligations: Let parameters change the load and who accompanies the test.
scenes.mapping_note: The capacity adjustment happens during the repair, before this test.

scenes.role: Check and mark the unrepaired wheel without risking a roll.
prerequisites: The cart has been parked out of service.
actions: Rock the axle by hand and mark the warning.
consequences: The failed test is recorded; the cart is not used as a cart.
prose_obligations: Make the safety choice explicit.
scenes.mapping_note: A separate local proof scene for the safe-stop branch.

scenes.role: Return the tool and acknowledge its usefulness.
prerequisites: The cart passed its test.
actions: Return the spanner; Len uses it to secure his vise.
consequences: The loan has helped the cart and remains useful at the bench.
prose_obligations: Track custody and use, not just a verbal thank-you.
scenes.mapping_note: Early and delayed admissions have distinct earned endings.

scenes.role: Close the failure route with a completed delivery and honest boundary.
scenes.location: courtyard repair bench and exchange table
prerequisites: The cart remains parked; seedlings reached the table by hand.
actions: Return the spanner; Len uses it on the vise; finish with the cart secured.
consequences: The cart is not repaired, but the children complete today's work safely.
prose_obligations: Do not leave every ending as a conditional future plan.
scenes.mapping_note: This ending shares the tool-return action but has a different outcome.

consolidation_notes.borrow: Combines cart arrival, asking Len, and his warning into one executable opening.
consolidation_notes.first_attempt: Combines support, size check, wrong diagnosis, and the jammed-wheel result; fit and bench conditions select local actions.
consolidation_notes.reinspect: Combines the tactile side-play check and discovery of the empty spacer gap.
consolidation_notes.repair: Combines unloading when necessary, retrieving the washer, and installing it.
consolidation_notes.ending_repaired and ending_rebuilt: Share physical return actions but are distinct scenes because the admission timing changes trust and prose.
consolidation_notes.not_executable: No inventory encounter silently fires. Each reference beat is either mapped to an implemented local scene, explicitly optional, or consolidated as noted above.
